svg.title: D4b operational proxy curves
svg.desc: Unsmoothed per-C seed means; columns K=8 and K=16; rows are evaluation splits. Solid lines are mixed-q rank proxies; dashed lines are outcome/lower-state NMI association proxies.
svg.text: Solid: mixed-q rank proxy; dashed: outcome/lower-state NMI association proxy (seed means)
